lines.en: Let's look at this map of our town.
Wow, Grandma. Where is our house?
lines.ko: 와, 할머니. 우리 집은 어디에 있어요?

lines.en: It's here, near the park.
Is the bakery on this street?
Yes, it's next to the tall building.
We went to that bakery last week.
Right. Can you find the station?
Yes. The station is at the end of the street.
Good job. Tomorrow we will walk there.
lines.ko: 잘했어요. 내일 우리 거기까지 걸어갈 거예요.

lines.en: Great! I will bring the map. Thank you, Grandma.
lines.ko: 좋아요! 할머니, 제가 지도를 가져갈게요. 고마워요.

lines.en: Excuse me. Where is the post office?
It's on the next street, near the station.
Is it far from here?
No, it's a short walk. Do you have a map?
lines.ko: 아니요, 조금만 걸으면 돼요. 지도 있으세요?

lines.en: Yes. I moved to this village last month.
lines.ko: 네. 지난달에 이 마을로 이사 왔어요.

lines.en: Welcome! The post office is the white building.
Oh, next to the bakery?
That's right. The bakery smells so good.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 그 빵집은 냄새가 정말 좋아요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will visit the bakery, too.
Have a nice day in our town.
